# On-prem configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-onprem-config-reference.mjs; edit the catalog there, then run `pnpm onprem:config-reference`. -->

`scripts/deployment-prepare.mjs` writes four private files (mode `0600`) into the
installation directory. Preparation generates every secret; none is printed and
none belongs in source control. Rerunning preparation is not an upgrade: keep the
directory and its secrets. `deploy/onprem/.env.onprem.example` lists the same
variables as a secret-free annotated example.

Column meaning: **Written** says when preparation writes the variable;
**Source** says who decides the value. Variables marked *operator* may be
edited in place, followed by `docker compose up -d` (Compose files) or a restart
of the host unit (`.env.readiness`, `.env.ingress`). Do not edit generated
secrets by hand; rotate them with the documented procedures. Keys inherited
unchanged from the pinned Supabase `self-hosted/v0.8.1` `docker/.env.example`
(for example `POSTGRES_HOST`, `POSTGRES_DB`, `API_GW_HTTP_PORT`) are not repeated here.

## `.env`

Compose interpolation for the whole stack (Supabase, dashboard and, with --with-posture-scanner, the AI Security Posture scanner). Read by `docker compose` from the installation directory.

| Variable | Written | Source | Value / default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `COMPOSE_FILE` | always | fixed by preparation | `compose.yml` | Compose file used when commands run from the installation directory. |
| `SUPABASE_PUBLIC_URL` | always | derived from options | `--supabase-url` | Public HTTPS API origin behind the customer ingress. |
| `API_EXTERNAL_URL` | always | derived from options | `<supabase-url>/auth/v1` | Auth callback base advertised by GoTrue. |
| `SITE_URL` | always | derived from options | `--dashboard-url` | Dashboard origin used in Auth redirects and emails. |
| `ADDITIONAL_REDIRECT_URLS` | always | derived from options | `<dashboard-url>/auth/callback,<dashboard-url>/auth/recover` | Only redirect targets Auth accepts. |
| `DISABLE_SIGNUP` | self-hosted only | fixed by preparation | `true` | Public signup is closed; provision accounts through bootstrap. |
| `AIDR_SIGNUP_MODE` | cloud only | fixed by preparation | `closed` | Managed-cloud signup mode (`closed` or `cloud`), mirrored by the dashboard. |
| `ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_USERS` | always | fixed by preparation | `false` | Anonymous Auth users are disabled. |
| `ENABLE_PHONE_SIGNUP` | always | fixed by preparation | `false` | Phone signup is disabled. |
| `ENABLE_PHONE_AUTOCONFIRM` | always | fixed by preparation | `false` | Phone numbers are never auto-confirmed. |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | PostgreSQL superuser password. |
| `JWT_SECRET` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | HS256 secret that signs the anon and service-role JWTs. |
| `ANON_KEY` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Public anon JWT (self-hosted); cloud mode writes a REPLACE_ placeholder for the project key. |
| `SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Service-role JWT (self-hosted); cloud mode writes a REPLACE_ placeholder. Never expose to browsers. |
| `DASHBOARD_PASSWORD` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Upstream Studio basic-auth password. |
| `SECRET_KEY_BASE` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Realtime and Supavisor cookie/session secret. |
| `VAULT_ENC_KEY` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Supabase Vault encryption key. |
| `REALTIME_DB_ENC_KEY` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Realtime database encryption key. |
| `PG_META_CRYPTO_KEY` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | postgres-meta connection encryption key. |
| `LOGFLARE_PUBLIC_ACCESS_TOKEN` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Upstream analytics public token (analytics is not started). |
| `LOGFLARE_PRIVATE_ACCESS_TOKEN` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Upstream analytics private token (analytics is not started). |
| `POOLER_TENANT_ID` | always | generated | `aidr-<random>` | Upstream pooler tenant id (the pooler service is removed). |
| `MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Upstream MinIO password (only used by the optional upstream S3 profile). |
| `S3_PROTOCOL_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Storage S3-protocol access key id. |
| `S3_PROTOCOL_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Storage S3-protocol secret; the doctor rejects the upstream demo value. |
| `AIDR_METRICS_TOKEN` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Bearer token for the dashboard metrics endpoint; required by Compose. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | always | operator | *(blank)* | Optional Studio SQL assistant key; blank disables it. |
| `SMTP_HOST` | always | operator | *(blank)* | SMTP relay host for Auth mail (password recovery). |
| `SMTP_USER` | always | operator | *(blank)* | SMTP user. |
| `SMTP_PASS` | always | operator | *(blank)* | SMTP password (secret). |
| `SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL` | always | operator | *(blank)* | Sender address for Auth mail. |
| `SMTP_SENDER_NAME` | always | fixed by preparation | `AIDR` | Display name for Auth mail. |
| `FUNCTIONS_VERIFY_JWT` | always | fixed by preparation | `false` | Edge Functions verify their own credentials; the gateway does not pre-verify JWTs. |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | not written; optional override | operator | *(blank)* | Optional dashboard error reporting DSN; blank disables it. |
| `SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT` | not written; optional override | operator | `production` | Sentry environment label (development installations default to `development`). |
| `SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE` | not written; optional override | operator | `0` | Sentry trace sampling rate. |
| `AIDR_AUTH_METHODS` | not written; optional override | operator | `password` | Dashboard sign-in methods offered to users. |
| `COMPOSE_PROFILES` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | fixed by preparation | `posture-scanner` | Starts the posture scanner services with the stack; remove `posture-scanner` to keep them stopped. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_SOURCE_VERSION` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | derived from options | `v4.6.1-aidr.1` | Pinned scanner source tag; also the scanner server and worker image tag. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_TZ` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | fixed by preparation | `UTC` | Time zone inside the posture scanner containers. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_AGENT_SHARED_SECRET` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | generated secret | *(secret)* | Authenticates worker registration and the internal scanner readiness route. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_TRUSTED_SIGNING_KEY_ID` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | operator | `--posture-scanner-signing-key-id` | Key id of the posture scanner release data-signing key. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_TRUSTED_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_SHA256` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | derived from options | `SHA-256 of the SPKI DER key` | Pinned fingerprint of `posture-scanner/signing-public.pem`. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_EXPECTED_DATA_BUNDLE_ID` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | derived from options | `aig-data-manifest.json bundle_id` | Signed scanner data bundle the runtime must attest. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | derived from options | `aig-data-manifest.json source.commit` | Scanner source commit the runtime must attest. |
| `BRIDGE_AUTH_MODE` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | fixed by preparation | `api_key` | Bridge authentication: `api_key` (isolated local sidecar) or `broker` (JWT). |
| `BRIDGE_API_KEY` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | generated secret | *(secret)* | Bearer key for bridge callers in `api_key` mode. |
| `BRIDGE_TASK_BACKEND` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | fixed by preparation | `sqlite` | Task registry: `sqlite` (single host) or `postgres` (HA). |
| `BRIDGE_HA_REQUIRED` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | fixed by preparation | `false` | `true` makes readiness refuse SQLite; set with the PostgreSQL backend. |
| `BRIDGE_EGRESS_PROXY_URL` | `--with-posture-scanner` only | fixed by preparation | `http://aig-egress:3128` | Deny-by-default egress gateway for remote scan traffic. |
| `BRIDGE_TASK_POSTGRES_DSN` | not written; optional override | operator | *(blank)* | PostgreSQL DSN for the HA task registry (secret); requires migrations 001 and 002. |
| `BRIDGE_JWT_SECRET` | not written; optional override | operator | *(blank)* | Broker-mode HS256 secret, at least 32 bytes (secret). |
| `BRIDGE_JWT_ISSUER` | not written; optional override | operator | *(blank)* | Broker-mode expected JWT issuer. |
| `BRIDGE_JWT_AUDIENCE` | not written; optional override | operator | *(blank)* | Broker-mode expected JWT audience. |
| `BRIDGE_JWT_REPLAY_DB` | not written; optional override | operator | `/app/state/jwt-replay.db` | SQLite JWT replay store (PostgreSQL backend uses the shared database). |
| `BRIDGE_AUTH_REQUIRED` | not written; optional override | operator | `true` | Inbound bridge authentication; never disable on a customer host. |
| `BRIDGE_TENANT_REQUIRED` | not written; optional override | operator | `true` | Require `X-AIDR-Tenant-ID` on scan requests. |
| `BRIDGE_REQUIRE_IDEMPOTENCY` | not written; optional override | operator | `true` | Require `Idempotency-Key` on submissions. |
| `BRIDGE_RUNTIME_EGRESS_REQUIRED` | not written; optional override | operator | `true` | Refuse remote scans unless an egress proxy is configured. |
| `BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ENABLED` | not written; optional override | operator | `true` | Enable tenant-scoped source uploads. |
| `BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ROOT` | not written; optional override | operator | `/app/uploads` | Upload volume path inside the bridge. |
| `BRIDGE_SOURCE_ROOT` | not written; optional override | operator | `/app/uploads` | Root that source-scan upload ids resolve beneath. |
| `BRIDGE_TASK_DB` | not written; optional override | operator | `/app/state/tasks.db` | SQLite task registry path on the bridge state volume. |
| `BRIDGE_CORS_ORIGINS` | not written; optional override | operator | *(blank)* | Browser origins allowed to call the bridge; blank allows none. |
| `BRIDGE_DOCS_ENABLED` | not written; optional override | operator | `false` | Serve API docs; enable only behind a protected ingress. |
| `BRIDGE_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | not written; optional override | operator | `52428800` | Maximum request body size. |
| `BRIDGE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS` | not written; optional override | operator | `false` | Allow private scan targets at submission (the egress gateway still refuses them). |
| `BRIDGE_VALIDATE_DNS` | not written; optional override | operator | `true` | Resolve and vet target hosts at submission; never disable for customers. |
| `BRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL` | not written; optional override | operator | `INFO` | Bridge log level. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_BIND_ADDRESS` | not written; optional override | operator | `127.0.0.1` | Host address the bridge port is published on. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_BRIDGE_PORT` | not written; optional override | operator | `8099` | Host port for the authenticated bridge. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_MIN_WORKERS` | not written; optional override | operator | `1` | Live workers required before the bridge reports ready. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_AGENT_COUNT` | not written; optional override | operator | `1` | Scanner worker replicas; keep 1 until workers expose unique identities. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_NO_PROXY` | not written; optional override | operator | `aig-server,localhost,127.0.0.1` | Destinations the worker reaches without the egress gateway. |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_HOST_PATH` | not written; optional override | operator | *(blank)* | Standalone docker-compose.posture-scanner.yml only: host path of the scanner signing public key (prepared installs use `posture-scanner/signing-public.pem`). |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST_PATH` | not written; optional override | operator | `./deploy/onprem/egress/allowlist.txt` | Standalone docker-compose.posture-scanner.yml only: egress allowlist path (prepared installs use `posture-scanner/egress/allowlist.txt`). |
| `POSTURE_SCANNER_BRIDGE_IMAGE_TAG` | not written; optional override | operator | `local` | Standalone docker-compose.posture-scanner.yml only: bridge image tag (prepared installs use the AIDR version). |

## `.env.functions`

Edge Functions runtime (`functions` service `env_file`). Holds the control-plane signing keys.

| Variable | Written | Source | Value / default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AIDR_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | always | derived from options | `--dashboard-url` | Browser origins allowed by Edge Function CORS. |
| `AIDR_DASHBOARD_URL` | always | derived from options | `--dashboard-url` | Dashboard origin used in links. |
| `AIDR_DASHBOARD_VERIFY_URL` | always | derived from options | `<dashboard-url>/verify` | Device verification page. |
| `AIDR_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN` | always | derived from options | `--supabase-url` | Public API origin endpoints are enrolled against. |
| `AIDR_DEVELOPMENT_MODE` | always | derived from options | `false` | `true` only for --development loopback installations. |
| `AIDR_ENTITLEMENT_SIGNING_KEY_ID` | always | generated | `aidr-<random>` | Entitlement signing key id. |
| `AIDR_ENTITLEMENT_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8_B64` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Ed25519 entitlement signing key (PKCS#8, base64). |
| `AIDR_REVOCATION_SIGNING_KEY_ID` | always | generated | `aidr-<random>` | Revocation list signing key id. |
| `AIDR_REVOCATION_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8_B64` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Ed25519 revocation signing key (PKCS#8, base64). |
| `AIDR_DELEGATION_ISSUER` | always | derived from options | `--supabase-url` | Issuer of delegated credentials; the doctor checks it matches this control plane. |
| `AIDR_DELEGATION_SIGNING_KEY_ID` | always | generated | `aidr-delegation-<random>` | Delegated credential signing key id. |
| `AIDR_DELEGATION_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8_B64` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Ed25519 delegated credential signing key. |
| `AIDR_DELEGATION_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_SPKI_B64` | always | generated | *(blank)* | Matching delegated credential verification key (public). |
| `AIDR_PACK_MASTER_KEY_B64` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Master key that encrypts policy/intel packs at rest. |
| `AIDR_ENABLE_LEGACY_SELF_SERVICE_BILLING` | always | fixed by preparation | `false` | Legacy self-service billing stays disabled. |
| `AIDR_PACK_DOWNLOAD_GRANT_SECRET` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | HMAC secret for short-lived pack download grants. |
| `AIDR_BILLING_PROVIDER` | always | operator | *(blank)* | Billing provider; blank for invoice/sales-led on-prem contracts. |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_INGRESS_SECRET` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Shared with `.env.ingress`; authenticates the device-start signer. |

## `.env.readiness`

Host readiness-evidence and SIEM maintenance worker (systemd units under `maintenance/`).

| Variable | Written | Source | Value / default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AIDR_DEPLOYMENT_DIR` | always | fixed by preparation | `/srv/aidr` | Installation directory the host workers operate on. |
| `AIDR_HEALTH_STATE_DIR` | always | fixed by preparation | `/srv/aidr/health` | Evidence files mounted read-only into the dashboard. |
| `AIDR_SIGNING_KEY_EXPIRES_AT` | always | generated | `prepared_at + 365 days` | Entitlement signing key rotation deadline (readiness evidence). |
| `AIDR_DELEGATION_SIGNING_KEY_EXPIRES_AT` | always | generated | `prepared_at + 365 days` | Delegation signing key rotation deadline. |
| `AIDR_TELEMETRY_QUEUE_ROOTS` | always | derived from options | `--telemetry-queue-root` | Fleet telemetry queue roots under /var/lib/aidr-telemetry. |
| `AIDR_DRAIN_SIEM` | always | fixed by preparation | `true` | The maintenance worker drains queued SIEM deliveries. |

## `.env.ingress`

Host device-start ingress signer (`ingress/device-start.mjs`) behind the TLS reverse proxy.

| Variable | Written | Source | Value / default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_INGRESS_SECRET` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Same value as in `.env.functions`. |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_PROXY_TOKEN` | always | generated secret | *(secret)* | Token the reverse proxy presents to the signer; independent of the ingress secret. |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_UPSTREAM_URL` | always | derived from options | `http://127.0.0.1:8000/functions/v1/device-start` | Edge Function the signer forwards to (cloud: provider HTTPS origin). |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_ANON_KEY` | self-hosted only | derived from options | `ANON_KEY` | Anon key the signer presents upstream. |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_LISTEN_HOST` | always | fixed by preparation | `127.0.0.1` | Signer listen address. |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_TRUSTED_PEERS` | always | fixed by preparation | `127.0.0.1,::1` | Exact peer addresses allowed to reach the signer. |
| `AIDR_DEVICE_START_LISTEN_PORT` | always | fixed by preparation | `8191` | Signer listen port. |

## Compose-level settings outside the environment files

- Resource budgets: `--profile small|medium|large` from `deploy/onprem/resource-profile.json`.
- Restart, log rotation and extra health checks: `deploy/onprem/compose.onprem.overlay.yml`.
- Posture scanner egress allowlist: `posture-scanner/egress/allowlist.txt` in a `--with-posture-scanner` installation.
- Installations prepared before the posture scanner rename keep working: every `POSTURE_SCANNER_*` Compose setting falls back to the name earlier releases wrote to `.env`.
